name: continuous-intelligence-sdlc
description: Continuous Intelligence for Product & Software Definition — AI quality gate across Jira, Confluence and Figma

scripts.dev: node scripts/check-path.mjs && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @ci/server" "npm run dev -w @ci/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ci/core && npm run test -w @ci/server
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @ci/core && npm run test:coverage -w @ci/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p e2e
